Provider: AI features are provided by the service at the address you enter on this page. Valnook provides no AI service and neither handles nor keeps what passes between you and that service.
When it connects: the app sends requests to that address only when you use bookkeeping by chat, read a share or run the checks.

Data sent: the text and pictures you enter or share; the current date, time and base currency; the names of bill categories that are not hidden; the names and currencies of favourite accounts (all accounts when none is a favourite); My rules and both nicknames; with "Send recent bills as hints" on, the notes and categories of the last 20 bills. The API key is sent in a request header.
Data not sent: account balances, credit limits, net worth, wallet contents, investment holdings and trades, pictures of you and the AI, and device information.

API key storage: the API key is encrypted on this device only, with keys managed by Android Keystore and content encrypted with AES-GCM. It is never uploaded to Valnook (which has no server), never included in local or OneDrive backups or file exports, and cannot be accessed from Web administration. After uninstalling, clearing app data, clearing all data or moving to a new device, it must be entered again.
Costs: any charges for using AI features are settled between you and the provider.
Local models: to keep data on your own devices or network, point the address at a model you run yourself.

AI-generated content may contain errors, is for reference only, does not represent Valnook\'s position and is not investment, financial or other advice; no bill is saved until you confirm it. To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, the developer is not liable for the provider\'s availability, charges or handling of data, or for loss arising from misuse of the API key.

Conversations: conversations and usage records are stored on this device only for 30 days and are not included in backups. How the provider keeps and uses the data it receives is governed by its own policy, which Valnook cannot control.

Recommendation: set a usage or spending limit for this API key with the provider (for example a daily or monthly cap) and grant it only the permissions needed; if you suspect the key has leaked, revoke or replace it with the provider at once.
Not sure what to enter? See the quick start
Valnook does not provide an AI service and does not relay your requests. To use the AI features, sign up for a third-party model service and enter its details in Settings.
This guide uses DeepSeek as an example of what to enter. Valnook has no partnership or affiliation with DeepSeek or its affiliates, and the example is not a recommendation.
The example follows DeepSeek\'s official documentation as checked on %1$s. The provider may change its addresses, model names, parameters or prices; its latest documentation prevails.
Links in this guide lead to third-party websites, which are responsible for their own content. Check each address before opening it.

Charges for using the AI features are billed by the provider. When you record bills, the text you enter, the pictures you send, and your category and account names are sent to the provider you entered.

We recommend creating a separate API key for Valnook, so its usage can be seen and the key can be turned off on its own. Keep the key safe: do not screenshot or forward it, or enter it in unknown apps or websites. If it may have leaked, delete it on the provider\'s platform at once. Valnook is not responsible for losses caused by a leaked or misused key.
Valnook works with services compatible with the OpenAI chat interface (Chat Completions). Three items are needed:
Base URL: the address the provider gives for requests.
API key: the access credential the provider issues, which identifies your account for billing.
Model: the name of the model that handles requests.
Three advanced parameters adapt requests to each provider; enter them as the provider\'s documentation describes.
Open the DeepSeek platform, then sign up and sign in.
Go to the API keys page and create a new API key.
Copy the key right away and keep it safe; it may not be shown in full again.
Top up your balance on the platform. Requests fail when the balance runs out.
The API key is stored encrypted on this device, is not included in backups, and is sent only to the provider you entered, with each request.
The base URL is where requests are sent; the provider gives it. DeepSeek\'s base URL is:
Do not add /chat/completions at the end; if entered, it is removed when saving.
An address starting with http:// is not encrypted and is only suitable for a model on your own network.

The model is the AI that handles requests; models differ in ability and price. Once the base URL and API key are entered, choose one from the list under the model field, or type its name if the list cannot be loaded.
This model supports tool calls and image understanding, which bookkeeping and picture recognition need.
Advanced parameters are JSON, merged into requests as written, for options specific to a provider. Tap \"Advanced parameters\" in Settings to show them.
Extra request parameters: sent with every request. Not needed in the DeepSeek example. When replies stop at the length limit, a larger limit can be set here, such as {\"max_tokens\": 16384}.
Thinking-off parameters: used while deep thinking is off. DeepSeek thinks by default, so enter:
Thinking-on parameters: used while deep thinking is on:
Deep thinking cannot be turned on while the thinking-on parameters are empty. It takes longer and costs more, so Valnook leaves it off by default.
When everything is entered, tap \"Save and check\". The check sends a few very small requests to the provider, which may cost a little.
Connection and tool calls: required to turn on the AI features.
Images and deep thinking: optional; each must pass before pictures can be sent or deep thinking turned on.
If a check fails, confirm in turn: the API key is correct and valid; the balance is sufficient; the base URL and model name are correct; the model supports tool calls.
Once the checks pass, turn on \"Turn on AI features\" at the top of the page.
Tap the button below to enter these DeepSeek example values in the connection settings. The API key is not entered or changed.
Nothing is saved yet. Return to Settings, enter your API key, then tap \"Save and check\".
The base URL, model and advanced parameters entered now will be replaced with the example values. The API key stays as it is.
